label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 33
title: MVP: cost modeling + FinOps views
body:
Dashboard must surface the FULL backend budget/cost/token machinery (not a subset):
- core/budget.py (budget.json: limits, usage, allocations, state{alerts,breakers,total_used,total_max}, history) - owner store.
- budget_allocator, budget_conservation, budget_planner (propose_tier -> feasible/exceeds_hard -> apply_proposal with approve), budget_protection, budget_tracker.
- cost_kpi, cost_modeling, finops; pipeline_telemetry (build_telemetry + cost history).
- run_breaker (RunBreaker/BreakerDecision; hard/soft ceilings; alerts.json de-duplicated).
- config/capacity.json: global_budget{soft_tokens,hard_tokens}, provider_limits{openrouter/opencode-go: tokens_per_min, requests_per_min}, max_concurrent_agents_per_project.
- Per-call token accounting from agent-audit-log.json: input/output/CACHED/total tokens, cost, cache_hit, chunking_used/chunks_count, model_context_window, truncated, retries, continuations, duration.
- Stores: budget.json, alerts.json, pipeline_cost_history.json, usage.jsonl, cost_metrics.jsonl, quality-metrics.json, pipeline-execution-report.json (cost_kpi + stage/agent tokens), byot_config.json (bring-your-own-tokens).
- Outcomes: attribution per tenant/user/project/stage/agent/model/tier; budget limits + 70/90/100% alerts; auto-mode cost caps; cost KPIs + FinOps report; basic forecasting + anomaly detection; per-tenant usage/cost reporting (chargeback-ready).
